profile.headline: Build & Ship
profile.summary: Full Stack Software Engineer, architect and develop high scale enterprise system.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.insights: Skills: Azure DevOps · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · .NET · Powershell · Azure Service Bus · Terraform · ArgoCD · Helm Charts

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered cloud-native integration pipelines for ingesting and processing high-volume vehicle telemetry using C# .NET 8, Python, Azure Function Apps, and Logic Apps, with seamless data flow across Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, and Databricks for real-time analytics and durable storage.
- Led Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) efforts using Terraform, ARM templates, and GitOps workflows with ArgoCD and Azure DevOps, ensuring full environment parity and automated, reliable deployments across dev, staging, and production.
- Built containerized microservices with Docker and Kubernetes (AKS), incorporating auto-scaling, and rolling deployments to support high availability with minimal downtime.
- Collaborated with engineering teams to resolve cloud-to-vehicle signal latency and transmission bottlenecks using optimized Kafka pipelines, Azure Event Hub, and Redis caching.
- Implemented real-time dashboards and alerts using Grafana, Prometheus, and Azure Monitor, reducing MTTR and improving observability for cloud-based microservices, reduced incident resolution time by 50%.
- Built internal developer portals using React.js, TypeScript including OAuth2 & Auth0 integrated onboarding platform, reducing operational overhead and support requests.
- Maintained code quality, compliance, environment validation, enhancing deployment confidence and developer velocity through Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, SonarQube, and Git version control across hybrid cloud environments including AKS, OpenShift, and AWS.
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) · Azure RedHat Openshift · Kafka Streams · Python (Programming Language) · Azure Databricks · Powershell · Microsoft Azure · Apache Kafka · Azure DevOps · JMeter · .NET Framework · Azure Service Fabric

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed a real-time voice assistant application featuring modern, responsive UI (using React.js, TypeScript, Axios) integrated with scalable back-end services built on .NET Core Web APIs, Azure Function Apps, and Node.js webhook APIs.
- Managed CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps, resolved deployment issues across environments, authored and maintained System Design Specifications for consistent documentation, and ensured code quality through Git version control and Enzyme front-end testing.
- Developed secure and scalable RESTful Web APIs using C# and .NET Core to support Microsoft’s School Data Sync system, enabling robust data validation and integration, utilizing Azure API Management (APIM) and OAuth 2.0 for secure access and integration. Extended platform functionality by integrating Azure Logic Apps and Function Apps to support complex, event-driven workflows.
- Automated infrastructure provisioning with ARM templates, streamlining deployments and improving environment consistency. Integrated Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines, test automation, improving reliability and delivery speed. Performed high-volume data manipulation and migration in Cosmos DB ensuring accuracy and performance across structured datasets.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, developed, and maintained a comprehensive sales system using Angular, .NET Core, Java, Electron and SQL Server supporting internal and external web applications, mobile apps, RESTful and SOAP APIs, microservices, and desktop clients.
- Managed the Supply Product system, collaborating directly with customers to gather requirements and resolve production issues. Ensured reliability and high user satisfaction by leveraging MVC, .NET Framework, and Azure Portal for deployment and monitoring.
- Built responsive and user-friendly interfaces with Angular Material, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and Bootstrap, enhancing usability across platforms.
- Integrated third-party systems and internal services using Web API, MuleSoft, and Node.js, facilitating smooth data flow and interoperability.
